title: sales-partnership-scratch-notes-netcloud
content:
Quick notes for NetCloud account - working draft.

Account snapshot
- Company: NetCloud (placeholder name) — mid-market SaaS, global MSP for networking + managed cloud services. ~2k employees, HQ US, EU ops.
- Key contacts (to confirm):
  - Head of AI/Automation: Priya Raman (possible),
  - VP Product: Samir Patel (POC),
  - Platform Eng lead: Elena Morales (tech eval)
- Tech stack: heavy AWS + GCP, some on-prem appliances for tier-1 customers. Uses Zendesk + Intercom for support.
- Current LLM approach: pilot with OpenAI for answers + internal Llama2 instances for embeddings/semantic search. Early perf notes: costs spiking at 100k msgs/month, latency issues for 3rd-party API, concerns about PII and compliance for telco customers.

Why Redwood might fit
- Predictable cost/sla: they care about steady ops and predictable unit economics for support use case.
- Private deployment option for regulated telco customers (on-prem/VPC + KMS) is big.
- Smart routing + fallback: can route non-sensitive requests to cheaper models, keep latency-critical to dedicated pools.
- Observability: token-level cost and regressions alerts map to their finance/ops needs.

Primary use cases to target
- Customer support automation: fast generative replies with retrieval + hallucination controls.
- Post-sale automation: install scripts, runbooks, triage workflows (low latency).
- Internal knowledge base search/assistant for field engineers (embeddings + reranking).

Account-specific pain points (from public signals + notes)
- Pricing sensitivity at scale (they saw 3x cost increase during pilot)
- Data residency & compliance for EU/telco customers
- Reliability: sometimes calls timeout when heavy batch jobs run in evenings
- Need clear audit logs / ability to revoke keys for contractors

Open questions to validate in discovery
- Actual monthly token volume for support assistant (estimate vs actual)
- Percent of requests that are latency-sensitive (<200ms requirement?)
- Which data is considered regulated / needs to stay in EU on-prem?
- Current contract length & renewal timing for pilot vendor

Outbound email drafts (A/B test)
- Subject A: "Reduce LLM cost and latency for NetCloud support"
- Body A: Hi Samir — quick note, we helped a networking MSP move from a mixed OpenAI + self-hosted setup to a unified inference layer that cut token costs by ~40% and reduced high-percentile latency with dedicated pools. If you have 15 min next week I can share the config that worked for their support flow.

- Subject B: "Private LLM deployment for NetCloud's regulated customers"
- Body B: Hey Priya — saw NetCloud's work in managed telco. We have a private option (VPC + KMS + audit logs) that customers use to comply with telco/regulatory needs while keeping the same API and developer experience. Interested in a short architecture review?

LinkedIn/DM quick outreach
- Short: Hi Priya — I work with teams building LLM assistants for MSPs. Would love 10 minutes to share a couple patterns that cut cost and improved SLAs.

Cold call script (opening)
- Hi, this is Derek from Redwood Inference. I know you're probably busy — quick question: when you ran your pilot, was cost or latency the bigger blocker to broader rollouts? (pause) If they say cost: we have reserved/dedicated options and batching profiles that typically reduce per-request costs by 20-50% for support workflows.

Discovery checklist
- Who owns LLM infra vs product?
- Pilot results: cost, latency percentiles, error rates, hallucination incidence
- Compliance: list of data classes that cannot leave region
- Key stakeholders for procurement and security review timeline

Objection handling (pricing)
- "We can't justify more spend" -> ask about current total cost of ownership: include infra, dev time for maintenance, and failed SLA incidents. Position Redwood as net savings via batching/caching + dedicated pools. Offer to run a cost-savings estimate using their pilot logs (ask for sample month).
- "We already use OpenAI and it's fine" -> probe scale + SLAs; highlight private option and predictable throughput + ability to pin model versions and rollouts for safety/regression control.
- "Vendor lock-in concerns" -> emphasize unified API, model catalog, and ability to run private + hosted. Provide example of customers who used Redwood to transition from expensive third-party calls to mixed routing with transparent fallbacks.

Technical pushbacks to be ready for
- "Does Redwood support our custom LLM?" -> yes, we support many open model families and can onboard model artifacts; note potential quantization/throughput tradeoffs.
- "How do you handle PII?" -> VPC/private control plane + KMS + audit logs; can show architecture diagram in technical review.

Pricing & product pathway to propose
- Short-term: Hosted API for POC with cost-savings suggestions from Redwood Optimize (intelligent batching + cache).
- Mid-term: Dedicated pool with reserved capacity when volume becomes predictable (monthly commit).
- Enterprise: Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) + platform fee + support for regulated customers.
- Ask for 1-month sample logs to run a quick cost-savings sim (low friction ask).

Metrics to include in follow-up deck
- Estimated monthly token spend before vs after (example show 40% reduction)
- 95th/99th percentile latency improvements with dedicated pools
- Number of incidents avoided with rollout/fallback policies

Next steps / TODOs
- Get contact emails and confirm org chart (reach out to Jordan to intros) — OWNER: Derek (this doc).
- Pull pilot logs request template for cost sim (use linked artifact NGP-1234 as template).
- Draft partner architecture slide for EU-residency questions (Maya assigned).
- Run A/B subject lines in Outreach sequences next Tue.

Notes to self
- Keep outbound concise and technical — target platform eng + product separately.
- Bring a concrete number (expected $ savings) to first call — that's the hook.
- If they ask for references, prioritize MSPs or networking customers.

Rough outreach schedule
- Day 0: LI message to Priya + email to Samir
- Day 3: follow-up email with one-pager + cost sim offer
- Day 10: call if no response, try different contact (Elena)

End of notes.

Unresolved items (for next update)
- Confirm exact org names and emails (Priya/Samir/Elena).
- Ask Solutions Eng for example of MSP deployment we can reference.

-- Derek
